'''Tseekoli''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] residing on [[Mek-Sha]] during the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]]. She owned a shipping business and was a friend of the [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] [[Veerla Mere]].
